paper_design_summary: No abstract or full text could be reached, so the design is not known. The metadata give only the title, which names generative AI and corporate innovation and contrasts innovation quantity with quality, in Technology in Society (2026, article 103488). The unit (firms), data source, and outcome measures cannot be confirmed from the records read.
